_about: T-453: the planner. step on every record = how many of the story's steps are done before it is reachable; show a record when the save has done at least that many (count the done_flag of each step in planner_story.json, bits as profile_layout explains). Each map's wild tables by edition (CONTENT, CONTEXT): day, and night where the map has one (T-268); land, water, rock_smash and fishing (old_rod, good_rod, super_rod), each daemon's slots summed into one rate (percent of that table) with its level range. The season, hour and weather homes (T-407, T-415) are not here. Left out on purpose: every place the game means to be found by playing, the islands only a ticket reaches, what lives in DOLDRUM CAVE, hidden items, fixed encounters, the GUIDE and the UNDERSTANDINGS, the NOTEBOOK and its books, and any line of the game's text.
